result.reason: The clause meets the CGL and certificate requirements and adopts the fallback E&O and cyber limits, but it omits workers' compensation coverage, so it does not satisfy even the complete fallback position. It also fails the preferred E&O and cyber limits. The added requirement to maintain all coverage for one year after the term goes beyond either stated position, making the redline non-minimal. The existing notices provision remains operative after renumbering, and no contradiction is introduced. Drafting quality is reduced by the omitted workers' compensation requirement, the absence of express privacy-liability terminology, and retention of the typographical error “five (5),days.”
